title: St. Thomas Taxi Association — current published rates (2022 tariff, displayed for 2026)
governanceNotes: Draft only. Do not mark verified or active until an administrator completes source-review attestation.
The St. Thomas Taxi Association labels its page “2026 Taxi Rates.” VIslandGuide and VInow identify the underlying Commission tariff as effective October 24, 2022 and still active in 2026.

The association page and VInow agree on the sampled primary routes but conflict on Red Hook to Dorothea for 2+ passengers ($15 on the association page versus $16 on VInow). That rule remains at the association source value and is flagged for Commission confirmation.

The current fare-rule schema can enforce the published $3 standard luggage charge. Night, waiting, round-trip, radio/phone dispatch, oversized luggage, hourly, sightseeing, kennel, and exclusive-taxi provisions require separate quoted-fare fields before they can be computed safely.
